summary.tpReason: Telemetry confirms four successful application credential additions by VadimJ across four separate enterprise applications. keyEvidence: AuditLogsHunting_CL contains exactly four successful credential-management updates by VadimJ, one each for EntApp01–EntApp04.

The four new credential identifiers are 1714a3cf-c8dc-40e6-bc2a-fdfaf55baf42, 8c123b9d-31e6-4f50-a21f-88eabc8857e5, bd3aa4f4-0737-42be-8506-1d2378a2ff0b, and a9d6190a-ee00-45ba-9975-4fa0b00bd4f4; each has Result=success.
The alert at 2026-08-19T18:01:05.057Z independently reports four credentials added to the same four applications and remains High/New.
Three events used Azure CLI/SDK with an MSI user agent, while one used an old Edge browser; this is unusual for a single ordinary interactive administration session.
No application sign-ins for EntApp01–EntApp04 were returned from sign_in_adelete_CL, so downstream credential use is not demonstrated.
